response.text:
I can’t keep watching the vendor portal in the background or message you later unless you create an automation I can trigger now. I won’t falsely say I’m “on it.”

I can help right away — pick one:
- Walk you through enabling the portal’s email/SMS push notifications (tell me the portal name and I’ll give steps).
- Draft a short message you can send to the vendor asking them to notify you the moment the SOC 2 is posted.
- Set up a calendar reminder for you to check after landing (tell me arrival time/time zone).
- If you can paste any portal page or the report link here, I’ll check it now and tell you what I find.

Which would you like me to do?
